rows.text: switches on word `[rcx+2]` with `p` = `rcx+8`: 0x3000 makes the call at `003EE260` + 0x27 with `p`; 0xB00 stores 2 to word `[p]` and makes the call at `003EE260` + 0x3C with `p`; 0x540 copies dword `[p]` to a stack dword, overwrites that copy's low word with 2 and makes the call at `003EE260` + 0x5B with the copy's address; any other value returns without a call
